options.content: **Cần trước khi có data:** bật `pg_stat_statements` (shared_preload_libraries → restart node-by-node) + `CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements` mỗi DB, và tạo Grafana **PostgreSQL datasource** (role read-only `zabbixmonitor`, DSN multi-host `10.1.1.103,104,105 ... target_session_attrs=read-write`). Xem `docs/monitoring/runbook-db-perf-security.md`. Chọn datasource ở biến **PostgreSQL datasource** phía trên.

panels.title: Top queries by TOTAL exec time

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.rolname AS usr, d.datname AS db, LEFT(s.query,200) AS query_text, s.calls, ROUND(s.total_exec_time::numeric,1) AS total_exec_time_ms, ROUND(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,2) AS mean_exec_time_ms, s.rows FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.dbid WHERE d.datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.rolname AS usr, d.datname AS db, LEFT(s.query,200) AS query_text, s.calls, ROUND(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,2) AS mean_exec_time_ms, s.rows FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.dbid WHERE d.datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY s.calls DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.rolname AS usr, d.datname AS db, LEFT(s.query,200) AS query_text, s.calls, ROUND(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,2) AS mean_exec_time_ms, s.rows FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.dbid WHERE s.calls>5 AND d.datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY s.mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.rolname AS usr, d.datname AS db, LEFT(s.query,200) AS query_text, s.calls, s.rows FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.dbid WHERE d.datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY s.rows DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.rolname AS usr, d.datname AS db, COUNT(*) AS distinct_queries, SUM(s.calls) AS total_calls, ROUND(SUM(s.total_exec_time)::numeric,1) AS total_exec_time_ms, ROUND(AVG(s.mean_exec_time)::numeric,2) AS avg_mean_ms FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.dbid GROUP BY r.rolname,d.datname ORDER BY total_calls DESC;

SELECT usename AS usr, datname AS db, COUNT(*) AS conns, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='active') AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='idle') AS idle, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='idle in transaction') AS idle_in_txn, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-state_change)))::int AS longest_idle_s FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid<>pg_backend_pid() GROUP BY usename,datname ORDER BY conns DESC;

panels.title: Idle in transaction (holds locks / blocks vacuum)

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, usename AS usr, datname AS db, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-state_change))::int AS idle_txn_age_s, LEFT(query,120) AS last_query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction' ORDER BY state_change ASC;

SELECT pid, usename AS usr, datname AS db, state, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-xact_start))::int AS xact_age_s, LEFT(query,120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY xact_start ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT pid, usename AS usr, datname AS db, wait_event_type, wait_event, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-query_start))::int AS waiting_s, pg_blocking_pids(pid) AS blocked_by, LEFT(query,120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid))>0 ORDER BY query_start ASC;

SELECT datname AS db, xact_commit, xact_rollback, ROUND(100.0*xact_rollback/NULLIF(xact_commit+xact_rollback,0),2) AS rollback_pct, deadlocks FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY rollback_pct DESC;

panels.title: Cache hit ratio & temp files per DB

targets.rawSql: SELECT datname AS db, ROUND(100.0*blks_hit/NULLIF(blks_hit+blks_read,0),2) AS cache_hit_pct, temp_files, pg_size_pretty(temp_bytes) AS temp_size FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY cache_hit_pct ASC;

SELECT schemaname AS schema, relname AS table, seq_scan, idx_scan, n_live_tup, ROUND(100.0*seq_scan/NULLIF(seq_scan+idx_scan,0),2) AS seq_scan_pct FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE n_live_tup>10000 ORDER BY seq_scan DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT schemaname AS schema, relname AS table, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, ROUND(100.0*n_dead_tup/NULLIF(n_live_tup+n_dead_tup,0),2) AS dead_pct, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Connections vs max / DB size / XID age

targets.rawSql: SELECT usename AS usr, COUNT(*) AS conns, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name='max_connections'),1) AS pct_of_max FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY usename ORDER BY conns DESC;

SELECT datname AS db, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS size, age(datfrozenxid) AS xid_age FROM pg_database WHERE datname NOT IN ('template0','template1') ORDER BY pg_database_size(datname) DESC;
